faq.a: Abdeslam is associated with the Arabic form عَبْدُ السَّلَام, whose core sense is abdeslam; servant of peace.

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdeslam?
faq.a: Abdeslam is associated with Arabic. Abdeslam is Arabic عَبْدُ السَّلَام (ʿAbd al-Salām), meaning 'servant of Peace'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ السَّلَام is Arabic.
Abdeslam can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdeslam should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Salām is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Abdeslam mean in Urdu?

faq.q: What does Abdeslam mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Abdeslam is rendered عبدالسلام and carries the sense عبدالسلام، بنده سلام.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Abdeslam, abdeslam. Script forms are عبدالسلام, عَبْدُ السَّلَام, अब्देसलाम.
